description: This file defines data models and repository logic for user authentication in a Flutter application, including handling tokens, login, registration, and secure storage interactions.

classes.name: TokenResponse
classes.description: Represents the result of an authentication operation, including access tokens, refresh tokens, and user info.

classes.name: AuthRepository
classes.description: Provides methods for login, registration, token retrieval, and logout, encapsulating API interaction and secure storage management.

methods.name: TokenResponse.fromJson
methods.description: Factory constructor that creates an instance of TokenResponse from JSON, handling different backend response formats.

methods.name: TokenResponse._unwrapCommonEnvelope
methods.description: Extracts core response data from common wrappers like { data: {...} } or { result: {...} }.

methods.name: TokenResponse._extractAccessToken
methods.description: Retrieves access token string from JSON, trying multiple key variants.

methods.name: TokenResponse._extractUser
methods.description: Extracts User object from JSON if available.

methods.name: AuthRepository.getStoredToken
methods.description: Retrieves the stored authentication token from secure storage.

methods.name: AuthRepository.login
methods.description: Performs login via API call and stores the received access token securely.

methods.name: AuthRepository.register
methods.description: Registers a new user and then logs in to obtain a token.

methods.name: AuthRepository.logout
methods.description: Logs out user by clearing secure token storage.

methods.name: _safeJson
methods.description: Ensures the response data is a JSON object or throws an error.
